extracted.intended_audience: general streaming viewers looking for curated TV and movie recommendations
extracted.subtask_description: An editorial, service-by-service and genre-by-genre curated guide that recommends the best movies, TV shows, and new titles currently available on major streaming platforms. Includes timely lists, genre roundups, how-to guides, industry news, and a weekly newsletter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive what-to-watch navigator
rubrics_metrics.description: Streamliner is Vulture’s comprehensive what-to-watch navigator: a regularly-updated overview of the best movies, TV shows, and original series for you to enjoy on the services of your choice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize recommendations across multiple streaming platforms (Netflix, HBO Max, Paramount+, Hulu, Disney+, Amazon Prime, Apple TV+, Peacock, plus 'Best of the Rest'). Aim for an overview that helps users find high-quality viewing options across services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regularly-updated / Timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: Regularly-updated overview; sections labelled 'now streaming' and 'The Best New Titles on [Service] This Month' emphasize current availability and monthly updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize currently available titles and recent additions; update lists on a recurring cadence (e.g., monthly or weekly) so recommendations reflect what users can actually watch now.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service-specific 'Best' lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Platform-targeted lists such as 'The Best Movies on Netflix Right Now', 'The Best TV Shows on HBO Max Right Now', and equivalents for each major streamer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curate separate 'best of' lists per streaming service so readers can browse by the service(s) they subscribe to; include both movies and TV shows where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre- and theme-specific curation
rubrics_metrics.description: Genre and theme roundups like 'The 20 Best Horror Movies on Netflix Right Now', 'The 20 Best Comedies', 'The Best Documentaries', 'The 13 Best Nature Documentaries on Disney+' and age- or interest-focused lists (e.g., 'Best Movies to Stream With Your Kids').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide focused lists by genre, theme, age group, or viewing occasion to help readers find titles that fit specific tastes or needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originals and platform exclusives
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists that highlight originals, e.g., 'The Best Netflix Original Movies' and 'Best Netflix Original Movies', and mentions of seasons and original series (e.g., 'Beef season 2').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Call out platform originals and exclusives as a distinct category since they can be a primary draw for subscribers; note season updates and new seasons where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-platform 'best' selections
rubrics_metrics.description: 'The Best Movies Across Every Streaming Service' — selections that pick the best titles regardless of platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When applicable, produce cross-service lists that recommend the top titles across multiple platforms rather than restricting to a single service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editor curation and named writer recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations and lists are 'curated by Vulture writers' and individual items are presented with bylines (e.g., Brian Tallerico, Eric Vilas-Boas).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rely on editorial judgment and critics' voices; include bylines and short commentary to signal subjective curation and explain choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental content: how-to guides and industry coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting pieces such as '10 Tips and Hacks to Get the Most Out of Peacock', 'How to Give Netflix, Hulu, and Other Streaming Services As Gifts', streaming industry news, recaps, and interviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Augment lists with practical guides, platform tips, industry reporting, and episodic recaps to provide context and utility beyond pure recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newsletter-based weekly picks
rubrics_metrics.description: SIGN UP FOR STREAMLINER — 'A weekly newsletter with the latest TV and movie recommendations, curated by Vulture writers.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer a newsletter that distills weekly editorial picks and updates to reach readers on a regular schedule and drive return engagement.
